standard-dialogue-before-while-guthix-sl.npc: Hello there. What can I do for you?
I mainly take in washing and make sure it's good and clean for my customers. Times are tough though. Not everyone can afford such a service and it's affecting my takings.

standard-dialogue-before-while-guthix-sl.player: Do you find that very fulfilling?

standard-dialogue-before-while-guthix-sl.npc: Well it can be a bit monotonous and the pay isn't good, but I set myself some goals and deliver my washing clean. My customers rarely complain, so I guess I must be doing something right.

standard-dialogue-after-while-guthix-sle.npc: Hello again. Do you need anything?
Well in that case, all the best.
